vsm2.17:298.1:
4. With triple round it spins forever (§288): here formations and becoming are the round of kamma. Ignorance,
craving and clinging are the round of defilements. Consciousness, mentality-materiality, the sixfold base,
contact and feeling are the round of result. So this Wheel of Becoming, having a triple round with these three rounds,
vsm2.17:298.2:
should be understood to spin, revolving again and again, forever, for the conditions
are not cut off as long as the round of defilements is not cut off.
vsm2.17:299.2:
> (1) As to the source in the four truths,
> (2) As to function, (3) prevention, (4) similes,
> (5) Kinds of profundity, and (6) methods,
> It should be known accordingly.
vsm2.17:300.1:
1. Herein, as to source in the truths: profitable and unprofitable kamma are stated in the Saccavibhaṅga
(Vibh 106f.) without distinction as the origin of suffering,
vsm2.17:300.2:
and so formations due to ignorance stated thus “With ignorance as condition there
are formations” are the second truth with the second truth as source.
vsm2.17:300.3: Consciousness due to formations is the first truth with the second truth as source.
vsm2.17:300.4:
The states beginning with mentality-materiality and ending with resultant feeling,
due respectively to consciousness, etc., are the first truth with the first truth as source.
vsm2.17:300.5: Craving due to feeling is the second truth with the first truth as source.
vsm2.17:300.6: Clinging due to craving is the second truth with the second truth as source.
vsm2.17:300.7: Becoming due to clinging is the first and second truths with the second truth as source.
vsm2.17:300.8: Birth due to becoming is the first truth with the second truth as source.
vsm2.17:300.9:
Ageing-and-death due to birth is the first truth with the first truth as source. This, in the first place,
is how the Wheel of Becoming should be known “as to … source in the four truths” in whichever way is appropriate.
vsm2.17:301.1:
2. As to function: ignorance confuses beings about physical objects of sense
desire and is a condition for the manifestation of formations;
vsm2.17:301.2: likewise kamma- formations form the formed and are a condition for consciousness;
vsm2.17:301.3: consciousness recognizes an object and is a condition for mentality-materiality;
vsm2.17:301.4: mentality-materiality is mutually consolidating and is a condition for the sixfold base;
vsm2.17:301.5: the sixfold base occurs with respect to its own separate objective fields and is a condition for contact;
vsm2.17:301.6: contact touches an object and is a condition for feeling;
vsm2.17:301.7: feeling experiences the stimulus of the object and is a condition for craving;
vsm2.17:301.8: craving lusts after lust-arousing things and is a condition for clinging;
vsm2.17:301.9: clinging clings to clinging-arousing things and is a condition for becoming;
vsm2.17:301.10: becoming flings beings into the various kinds of destiny and is a condition for birth;
vsm2.17:301.11: birth gives birth to the aggregates owing to its occurring as their generation and is a condition for ageing-and-death;
vsm2.17:301.12:
and ageing-and-death ensures the decay and dissolution of the aggregates and is a condition
for the manifestation of the next becoming because it ensures sorrow, etc.
vsm2.17:301.13:
So this Wheel of Becoming should be known accordingly as occurring in two ways
“as to function” in whichever way is appropriate to each of its parts.
vsm2.17:302.1: 3. As to prevention: the clause “With ignorance as condition there are formations” prevents seeing a maker;
vsm2.17:302.2: the clause “With formations as condition, consciousness” prevents seeing the transmigration of a self;
vsm2.17:302.3:
the clause “With consciousness as condition, mentality-materiality” prevents perception of compactness
because it shows the analysis of the basis conjectured to be “self”;
vsm2.17:302.4:
and the clauses beginning “With mentality-materiality as condition, the sixfold base” prevent seeing any self
that sees, etc., cognizes, touches, feels, craves, clings, becomes, is born, ages and dies.
vsm2.17:302.5: So this Wheel of Becoming should be known “as to prevention” of wrong seeing appropriately in each instance.
vsm2.17:303.1:
4. As to similes: ignorance is like a blind man because there is no seeing states
according to their specific and general characteristics;
vsm2.17:303.2: formations with ignorance as condition are like the blind man’s stumbling;
vsm2.17:303.3: consciousness with formations as condition is like the stumbler’s falling;
vsm2.17:303.4: mentality-materiality with consciousness as condition is like the appearance of a tumour on the fallen man;
vsm2.17:303.5: the sixfold base with mentality-materiality as condition is like a gathering that makes the tumour burst;
vsm2.17:303.6: contact with the sixfold base as condition is like hitting the gathering in the tumour;
vsm2.17:303.7: feeling with contact as condition is like the pain due to the blow; craving with feeling as condition is like longing for a remedy;
vsm2.17:303.8: clinging with craving as condition is like seizing what is unsuitable through longing for a remedy;
vsm2.17:303.9: becoming with clinging as condition is like applying the unsuitable remedy seized;
vsm2.17:303.10:
birth with becoming as condition is like the appearance of a change for the worse in the tumour
owing to the application of the unsuitable remedy;
vsm2.17:303.11: and ageing-and-death with birth as condition is like the bursting of the tumour after the change.
vsm2.17:303.12: Or again, ignorance here as “no theory” and “wrong theory” (see §52) befogs beings as a cataract does the eyes;
vsm2.17:303.13:
the fool befogged by it involves himself in formations that produce further becoming,
as a cocoon-spinning caterpillar does with the strands of the cocoon;
vsm2.17:303.14:
consciousness guided by formations establishes itself in the destinies,
as a prince guided by a minister establishes himself on a throne;
vsm2.17:303.15:
death consciousness conjecturing about the sign of rebirth generates mentality-materiality in its various
aspects in rebirth-linking, as a magician does an illusion;
vsm2.17:303.16:
the sixfold base planted in mentality-materiality reaches growth, increase and fulfilment,
as a forest thicket does planted in good soil;
vsm2.17:303.17: contact is born from the impingement of the bases, as fire is born from the rubbing together of fire sticks;
vsm2.17:303.18: feeling is manifested in one touched by contact, as burning is in one touched by fire;
vsm2.17:303.19: craving increases in one who feels, as thirst does in one who drinks salt water;
vsm2.17:303.20: one who is parched with craving conceives longing for the kinds of becoming, as a thirsty man does for drinks;
vsm2.17:303.21: that is his clinging; by clinging he clings to becoming as a fish does to the hook through greed for the bait;
vsm2.17:303.22: when there is becoming there is birth, as when there is a seed there is a shoot;
vsm2.17:303.23: and death is certain for one who is born, as falling down is for a tree that has grown up.
vsm2.17:303.24: So this Wheel of Becoming should be known thus “as to similes” too in whichever way is appropriate.
vsm2.17:304.1:
5. Kinds of profundity: Now, the Blessed One’s words, “This dependent origination is profound, Ānanda, and profound it
appears” (D II 55), refer to profundity (a) of meaning, (b) of law, (c) of teaching, and (d) of penetration.
vsm2.17:304.2: So this Wheel of Becoming should be known “as to the kinds of profundity” in whichever way is appropriate.
vsm2.17:305.1:
(a) Herein, the meaning of ageing-and-death produced and originated with birth as condition is profound owing to difficulty
in understanding its origin with birth as condition thus: Neither does ageing-and death not come about from birth, nor,
failing birth, does it come about from something else; it arises only from birth with precisely that nature of ageing-and-death.
vsm2.17:305.2:
And the meaning of birth with becoming as condition … and the meaning of formations
produced and originated with ignorance as condition are treatable in like manner.
vsm2.17:305.3: That is why this Wheel of Becoming is profound in meaning. This, firstly, is the profundity of meaning here.
vsm2.17:305.4:
For it is the fruit of a cause that is called “meaning,” according as it is said, “Knowledge
about the fruit of a cause is the discrimination of meaning” (Vibh 293).
vsm2.17:306.1:
(b) The meaning of ignorance as condition for formations is profound since it is difficult to understand in what
mode and on what occasion ignorance is a condition for the several formations …
vsm2.17:306.2: The meaning of birth as a condition for ageing-and-death is similarly profound.
vsm2.17:306.3: That is why this Wheel of Becoming is profound in law. This is the profundity of law here.
vsm2.17:306.4: For “law” is a name for cause, according as it is said, “Knowledge about cause is discrimination of law” (Vibh 293).
vsm2.17:307.1:
(c) Then the teaching of this dependent origination is profound since it needs to be given in various
ways for various reasons, and none but omniscient knowledge gets fully established in it;
vsm2.17:307.2:
for in some places in the suttas it is taught in forward order, in some in backward order, in some in forward and backward
order, in some in forward or in backward order starting from the middle,
vsm2.17:307.3: in some in four sections and three links, in some in three sections and two links, and in some in two sections and one link.
vsm2.17:307.4: That is why this Wheel of Becoming is profound in teaching. This is the profundity of teaching.
vsm2.17:308.1:
(d) Then the individual essences of ignorance, etc., owing to the penetration of which ignorance, etc.,
are rightly penetrated as to their specific characteristic, are profound since they are difficult to fathom.
vsm2.17:308.2: That is why this Wheel of Becoming is profound in penetration.
vsm2.17:308.3: For here the meaning of ignorance as unknowing and unseeing and non-penetration of the truth is profound;
vsm2.17:308.4: so is the meaning of formations as forming and accumulating with and without greed;
vsm2.17:308.5: so is the meaning of consciousness as void, uninterested, and manifestation of rebirth-linking without transmigration;
vsm2.17:308.6:
so is the meaning of mentality-materiality as simultaneous arising, as resolved into components
or not, and as bending on to an object (namana) and being molested (ruppana);
vsm2.17:308.7: so is the meaning of the sixfold base as predominance, world, door, field, and possession of objective field;
vsm2.17:308.8: so is the meaning of contact as touching, impingement, coincidence, and concurrence;
vsm2.17:308.9:
so is the meaning of feeling as the experiencing of the stimulus of an object,
as pleasure or pain or neutrality, as soulless, and as what is felt.
vsm2.17:308.10:
So is the meaning of craving as a delighting in, as a committal to, as a current, as a bindweed,
as a river, as the ocean of craving, and as impossible to fill;
vsm2.17:308.11: so is the meaning of clinging as grasping, seizing, misinterpreting, adhering, and hard to get by;
vsm2.17:308.12:
so is the meaning of becoming as accumulating, forming, and flinging into the various
kinds of generation, destiny, station, and abode;
vsm2.17:308.13: so is the meaning of birth as birth, coming to birth, descent into the womb, rebirth, and manifestation;
vsm2.17:308.14: and so is the meaning of ageing-and-birth as destruction, fall, break-up and change. This is profundity of penetration.
vsm2.17:309.1:
6. As to methods: Then there are four methods of treating the meaning here. They are (a) the method of identity,
(b) the method of diversity, (c) the method of uninterest, and (d) the method of ineluctable regularity.
vsm2.17:309.2: So this Wheel of Becoming should also be known accordingly “as to the kinds of method.”
vsm2.17:310.1:
(a) Herein, the non-interruption of the continuity in this way, “With ignorance as condition there
are formations; with formations as condition, consciousness,” just like a seed’s reaching the state of a tree
through the state of the shoot, etc., is called the “method of identity.”
vsm2.17:310.2:
One who sees this rightly abandons the annihilation view by understanding the unbrokenness of the continuity
that occurs through the linking of cause and fruit.
vsm2.17:310.3:
And one who sees it wrongly clings to the eternity view by apprehending identity in the non-interruption
of the continuity that occurs through the linking of cause and fruit.
vsm2.17:311.1: (b) The defining of the individual characteristic of ignorance, etc., is called the “method of diversity.”
vsm2.17:311.2: One who sees this rightly abandons the eternity view by seeing the arising of each new state.
vsm2.17:311.3:
And one who sees it wrongly clings to the annihilation view by apprehending individual
diversity in the events in a single continuity as though it were a broken continuity.
vsm2.17:312.1:
(c) The absence of interestedness on the part of ignorance, such as “Formations must be made to occur by me,” or on the part
of formations, such as “Consciousness must be made to occur by us,” and so on, is called the “method of uninterestedness.”
vsm2.17:312.2: One who sees this rightly abandons the self view by understanding the absence of a maker.
vsm2.17:312.3:
One who sees it wrongly clings to the moral-inefficacy-of-action view, because he does not perceive that the causative
function of ignorance, etc., is established as a law by their respective individual essences.
vsm2.17:313.1:
(d) The production of only formations, etc., respectively and no others with ignorance, etc., as the respective reasons,
like that of curd, etc., with milk, etc., as the respective reasons, is called the “method of ineluctable regularity.”
vsm2.17:313.2:
One who sees this rightly abandons the no-cause view and the moral-inefficacy-of-action
view by understanding how the fruit accords with its condition.
vsm2.17:313.3:
One who sees it wrongly by apprehending it as non-production of anything from anything, instead of apprehending the occurrence of
the fruit in accordance with its conditions, clings to the no-cause view and to the doctrine of fatalism. So this Wheel of Becoming:
vsm2.17:313.4:
> As to source in the four truths,
> As to function, prevention, similes,
> Kinds of profundity, and methods,
> Should be known accordingly.
vsm2.17:314.1:
There is no one, even in a dream, who has got out of the fearful round of rebirths, which is ever destroying like a thunderbolt,
unless he has severed with the knife of knowledge well whetted on the stone of sublime concentration, this Wheel of Becoming,
which offers no footing owing to its great profundity and is hard to get by owing to the maze of many methods.
vsm2.17:314.2: And this has been said by the Blessed One: “This dependent origination is profound, Ānanda, and profound it appears.
vsm2.17:314.3:
And, Ānanda, it is through not knowing, through not penetrating it, that this generation
has become a tangled skein, a knotted ball of thread, root-matted as a reed bed, and finds no way
out of the round of rebirths, with its states of loss, unhappy destinies, … perdition” (D II 55).
vsm2.17:314.4: Therefore, practicing for his own and others’ benefit and welfare, and abandoning other duties:
vsm2.17:314.5:
> Let a wise man with mindfulness
> So practice that he may begin
> To find a footing in the deeps
> Of the dependent origin.
vsm2.17:314.6:
The seventeenth chapter called “The Description of the
Soil of Understanding” in the Treatise on the Development
of Understanding in the Path of Purification composed for
the purpose of gladdening good people.
